essayTitle: Report on the Cyber Safety Awareness Programme
source: SPM 2026 Trial · Johor (Set 3) · English Paper 2 · Part 3 Q4 · Report, 200–250 words
paragraphs: The purpose of this report is to give an account of the Cyber Safety Awareness Programme attended by ICT Club members on 14 August 2026.

The programme was held at the school's Multipurpose Hall. In my opinion, the venue was highly suitable because it was spacious enough to accommodate all 120 participants. Moreover, it was equipped with a large projector screen and a clear sound system, so everyone could follow the talk comfortably.

A common cyber safety issue highlighted in the programme was phishing scams. Scammers send fake messages or links that look official in order to steal passwords and personal information. Alarmingly, the speaker revealed that many teenagers fall prey to such scams because they click on links without thinking twice.

Firstly, one way to improve our online safety is to create strong passwords and enable two-factor authentication. This adds an extra layer of protection even if a password is compromised. Furthermore, we should never disclose sensitive information such as our IC number or home address on social media. Doing so reduces the risk of identity theft.

All in all, the programme was a resounding success and an eye-opening experience for all participants. It is recommended that a similar programme be organised annually so that more students can navigate the digital world safely.
